name: Grass Medium 02 — individual pasture specimens
author: Rico Cilliers
derivation: Split the existing five-plant gallery into individual specimens, simplify each leaf component with meshoptimizer1.1.1 at0.03 error with source extrema locked, and recenter each specimen at its own ground root. Retained position/normal/UV source values except translation; embedded images and material unchanged.
runtime: assets/mixed-sward.mjs reads geometry only and reuses the existing scanned-grass material and its textures. The five meshes form a variant library; do not place the whole library as one clump. Use each node sourceHeight for uniform scale.
textures: The inherited albedo is RGB. True leaf geometry supplies the contour; it is not a transparent billboard atlas.
